import bpy, math
prefs = bpy.context.preferences.addons["cycles"].preferences
try:
    prefs.compute_device_type = "OPTIX"
    prefs.refresh_devices()
    for d in prefs.devices:
        d.use = d.type == "OPTIX"
    gpu = [d.name for d in prefs.devices if d.use]
except TypeError:
    gpu = []
scene = bpy.context.scene
scene.render.engine = "CYCLES"
scene.cycles.device = "GPU" if gpu else "CPU"
tree = scene.world.node_tree
sky = tree.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexSky")
try:
    sky.sky_type = "MULTIPLE_SCATTERING"
except TypeError:
    sky.sky_type = "NISHITA"
sky.sun_elevation = math.radians(params["elevation"])
sky.sun_rotation = math.radians(params["rotation"])
sky.sun_intensity = params["sun_intensity"]
setattr(sky, "aerosol_density" if hasattr(sky, "aerosol_density") else "dust_density", params["aerosol"])
sky.air_density = params["air"]
background = tree.nodes["Background"]
tree.links.new(sky.outputs["Color"], background.inputs["Color"])
background.inputs["Strength"].default_value = params["strength"]
result = {"device": scene.cycles.device, "gpu": gpu}

import bpy
mat = bpy.data.materials.new("CloudMat")
mat.use_nodes = True
nt = mat.node_tree
nt.nodes.clear()
add = nt.nodes.new
coord, mapping, noise = add("ShaderNodeTexCoord"), add("ShaderNodeMapping"), add("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
ramp, mix, out = add("ShaderNodeValToRGB"), add("ShaderNodeMixShader"), add("ShaderNodeOutputMaterial")
clear, glow = add("ShaderNodeBsdfTransparent"), add("ShaderNodeEmission")
mapping.inputs["Scale"].default_value = (6, 12, 6)
noise.inputs["Scale"].default_value = 2.5
noise.inputs["Detail"].default_value = 10
noise.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.62
ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].position = 0.5
ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].position = 0.72
glow.inputs["Color"].default_value = (1.0, 0.48, 0.32, 1)
glow.inputs["Strength"].default_value = 1.2
for a, b in ((coord.outputs["Generated"], mapping.inputs["Vector"]), (mapping.outputs[0], noise.inputs["Vector"]),
             (noise.outputs["Fac"], ramp.inputs["Fac"]), (ramp.outputs["Color"], mix.inputs["Fac"]),
             (clear.outputs[0], mix.inputs[1]), (glow.outputs[0], mix.inputs[2]), (mix.outputs[0], out.inputs["Surface"])):
    nt.links.new(a, b)
bpy.data.objects["Clouds"].data.materials.append(mat)
